Any of several customary units of length derived from the 1593 English statute mile of 8 furlongs, equivalent to 5,280 feet or 1,760 yard…

mile.ety: From Middle English myle, mile, from Old English mīl, from Proto-West Germanic *mīliju, a borrowing of Latin mīlia, mīllia, plural of mīle, mīlle (“mile”) (literally ‘thousand’ but used as a short form of mīlle passūs (“a thousand paces”)).

ex.en: The post office is half a mile away.
ex.ja: 郵便局は半マイル向こうにある。

ex.en: Five miles is a long distance to walk.
ex.ja: ５マイルは歩くには長い距離だ。

ex.en: The farm is three miles beyond the river.
ex.ja: 農場は川の３マイル向こうにある。

en: In close approximation; almost, virtually.
With close relation; intimately.

nearly.ety: From near + -ly. Cognate with Scots nerelie, neirlie (“nearly”). Compare also English nearling, nearlings.

ex.en: He was nearly run over by a car.
ex.ja: 彼は危うく車にはねられるところだった。

ex.en: That bridge took nearly three years to build.
ex.ja: その橋の建設には３年近くかかりました。

ex.en: He comes to see me nearly every day.
ex.ja: 彼はほとんど毎日私に会いに来てくれる。

en: Specific; discrete; concrete.
Specialised; characteristic of a specific person or thing.
A small individual part of something larger; a detail, a point.
A particular case; an individual thing as opposed to a whole class. (Opposed to generals, universals.)

particular.ety: From Middle English particuler, from Anglo-Norman particuler, Middle French particuler, particulier, from Late Latin particularis (“partial; separate, individual”), from Latin particula (“(small) part”). Equivalent to particle + -ar. Compare particle.

ex.en: Do you have anything to say in particular?
ex.ja: 何か特に言う事がありますか。

ex.en: Do you have any particular style in mind?
ex.ja: 特にお望みの型はございますか。

ex.en: I have nothing in particular to do tomorrow.
ex.ja: 明日は特に何もすることがありません。

note.ja: part（部分）+ icul（小さな）+ ar。小さな部分の →「特定の・特別な・細かい」。

en: Prior; occurring before something else, either in time or order.
Premature; acting or occurring too soon.
An existing criminal record (short for "previous convictions")
A track record of similar behaviour, especially bad behaviour.

ex.en: I'm sorry, but I have a previous appointment.
ex.ja: 残念ですが、私には先約があります。

ex.en: I had lost a camera the previous day.
ex.ja: 私はその前日にカメラをなくしてしまった。

ex.en: Tom has two children from a previous marriage.
ex.ja: トムには連れ子が二人いるんだ。

en: Rapidly; with speed; fast; with expedition.
Very soon.

quickly.ety: From Middle English quykly, quikliche, quicliche, cwikliche, cwickliche, from Old English cwiculīċe. By surface analysis, quick + -ly.

ex.en: The class being over, the students left quickly.
ex.ja: 授業が終わると、生徒達は急いで帰って行った。

ex.en: The good news spread through the village quickly.
ex.ja: その吉報は大変すばやく村中に広がった。

ex.en: The world is changing more and more quickly.
ex.ja: 世界はますます急速に変化している。

en: Any considerable and connected part of a space or surface; specifically, a tract of land or sea of considerable but indefinite extent; a …
Such a division of the city of Rome and of the territory about Rome, of which the number varied at different times; a district, quarter, …

region.ety: From Middle English regioun, from Anglo-Norman regiun, from Latin regiō, from regō. Doublet of regio.

ex.en: In the southern region, sales were up 47 percent.
ex.ja: 南部の売り上げは４７パーセント増加した。

ex.en: This video is not available in your region.
ex.ja: この動画はお住まいの地域ではご利用いただけません。

ex.en: The region is a production center for tea leaves.
ex.ja: その地方はお茶の産地です。

note.ja: ラテン語 regio（境界線・地域）から。reg（まっすぐ・支配する）+ ion。支配の及ぶ範囲 →「地域・地方」。

en: A cutting; a part cut out from the rest of something.
A part, piece, subdivision of anything.
To cut, divide or separate into pieces.
To reduce to the degree of thinness required for study with the microscope.

section.ety: From Middle English seccioun, from Old French section, from Latin sectiō (“cutting, cutting off, excision, amputation of diseased parts of the body, etc.”), from sectus, past participle of secāre (“to cut”). More at saw.

ex.en: She is attached to the general affairs section.
ex.ja: 彼女は庶務課に所属している。

ex.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?
ex.ja: 誰が営業部を担当しているのですか。

ex.en: His shop is in a busy section of town.
ex.ja: 彼の店は町の賑やかな区域にある。

note.ja: sect（切る）+ ion。切り分けた部分 →「区分・部分」。insect（体が切れ目で分かれた生き物→昆虫）も同じ sect。
